info.flavor: Monsoon-class frames date back to the Maguayan civil war and were first developed by Flue for the defense of Opal's capital city. The archetype's defining characteristics are the use of advanced e-warfare systems to secure a defensive perimeter and bursts of overwhelming firepower to pre-empt approach. Modern incarnations incorporate technology from IPS-N's Raleigh platform to smoothly transition between shielded and firing stances.
info.tactics: True to its namesake, the Monsoon alternates between wielding long-range firepower and shielding itself from close-quarters fire. It can protect nearby allies by granting them hard cover and redirecting attacks towards itself. Clever foes will exploit its inability to control when its shields are down, as well as its reliance on offense to handle ranged attackers.
info.terse: Dual artillery-defender that switches between offensive and defensive stances each turn.

name: Habagat Oscillatory Shields
effect: At the start of the Monsoon's turn, if it is unable to attack any hostile characters with the Typhoon Flechette Launcher, it gains Resistance to all damage from attacks that originate within Range 5 until the end of the round. At the end of the Monsoon's turn, if it did not attack with the Typhoon Flechette Launcher, it automatically reloads that weapon.

actions.name: Raise Shields
actions.trigger: You start your turn unable to attack any hostile characters with the Typhoon Flechette Launcher.
actions.detail: Gain Resistance to all damage from attacks that originate within Range 5 until the end of the round.

active_effects.name: Habagat Oscillatory Shields
active_effects.detail: Until the end of the round, you have Resistance to all damage from attacks that originate within Range 5.

actions.name: Reload Launcher
actions.trigger: You end your turn without having attacked with the Typhoon Flechette Launcher.
actions.detail: You automatically reload the Typhoon Flechette Launcher.

name: Guardian
effect: Adjacent allied characters can use the Monsoon for hard cover.

active_effects.name: Guardian
active_effects.detail: Allied characters can use you for hard cover.

name: Sturdy Frame
effect: If the Monsoon is not Immobilized, when it is pushed, pulled, or knocked back, its movement is halved.

active_effects.name: Sturdy Frame
active_effects.condition: You are not Immobilized and you are pushed, pulled, or knocked back.

actions.name: Rain Shadow
actions.trigger: A character within Sensors attacks an allied character within Range 5.
actions.detail: You hijack the attacker's systems, forcing them to instead target you even if they normally could not. If the attack is part of an area of effect, the area must be repositioned to include you, which may change its targets.

name: Kinetic Reservoir
effect: When the Monsoon makes an attack, it may expend any number of charges from this system to push targets the same number of spaces directly away on hit. The Monsoon regains 2 charges each time it is hit by a ranged or melee attack.

actions.name: Release Kinetic Reservoir
actions.detail: Expend any number of charges from Kinetic Reservoir to push targets the same number of spaces directly away on hit.

active_effects.name: Fill Kinetic Reservoir
active_effects.condition: You are hit by a ranged or melee attack.

actions.name: Memetic Caltrops
actions.detail: You spread paralytic memetics across a free Blast 1 area within Sensors. Hostile characters that start their turn at least partially within the area or move at least partially into it for the first time in a round take {2/3/4} AP Energy damage and must pass a Systems save or become Impaired and Slowed until the end of their next turn. The area lasts until you take this action again or become Jammed or Shredded.

actions.name: Flood Targeting
actions.detail: Make a tech attack against a hostile character within Sensors. On a hit, until the start of your next turn, the target takes {2/3/4} AP Energy damage each time they make an attack roll that does not target you.

add_special.detail: When you make an attack roll that does not target the Monsoon, take {2/3/4} AP Energy damage.

name: Galeforce Repulsor
effect: At the start of the Monsoon's turn, if it is unable to attack any hostile characters with the Typhoon Flechette Launcher, it may wreathe itself in a whirling energy field. While the field is active, when a ranged or melee attack hits the Monsoon, all damage is reduced to 0, and the field dissipates. All characters always know whether the field is active.

actions.name: Charge Galeforce Repulsor
actions.trigger: Your start your turn unable to attack any hostile characters with the Typhoon Flechette Launcher.
actions.detail: Wreathe yourself in a whirling energy field that reduces all damage from the next successful ranged or melee attack against you to 0.

active_effects.name: Galeforce Repulsor
active_effects.condition: You are hit by a ranged or melee attack.
active_effects.detail: All damage is reduced to 0 and this effect deactivates.

actions.name: Load Hailstone Rounds
actions.detail:
Load a special servo-crippling round. The next time you use the Typhoon Flechette Launcher to Barrage, choose one of the following on-hit effects:
  • Halt: Targets must make an Engineering save. On a failure, they become Immobilized until the end of their next turn; on a success, they become Slowed instead.
  • Disable: Targets must make a Systems save. On a failure, they become Jammed until the end of their next turn; on a success, they become Impaired instead.

active_effects.name: Halter Rounds
active_effects.detail: Targets hit by the Typhoon Flechette Launcher must make an Engineering save. On a failure, they become Immobilized until the end of their next turn; on a success, they become Slowed instead.

active_effects.name: Disabler Rounds
active_effects.detail: Targets hit by the Typhoon Flechette Launcher must make a Systems save. On a failure, they become Jammed until the end of their next turn; on a success, they become Impaired instead.

name: Amihan Interdiction Routines [Veteran]
effect: Rain Shadow also triggers when a character within Sensors forces an allied character within Range 5 to make a save. If Rain Shadow is triggered in this way, the Monsoon makes the save instead and receives all effects.
